design: Out-of-campaign replication of the context decision and search with linear predictors; fixed before computing any of these results.
selection_reason: One locally bundled scikit-learn non-image tabular data set per binary, multiclass and continuous response, taking the largest row count per task among the bundled examples exposing numeric measurement features.
splits: 60% train, 20% ranking, 20% test; two deterministic stratified splits for classification, unstratified for regression.
learner: Standardize using training statistics; logistic regression C=1 or ridge alpha=1. Refit frozen subsets on train plus ranking for test.
ranking: Descending RMS standardized coefficient across outputs, index as tie-break. Anchor is the shortest prefix satisfying a relative 8% loss cap against the fitted full predictor on all ranking rows, jointly for accuracy and AUC or clipped R2 and MAE. Input outside the current mask is filled by training medians.
contexts: Empty extension, next k ranked columns, and entire ranked tail; collapse duplicate extensions.
votes: Use the main method's fixed panels, relative tolerances (3%, 5% for rare-class AP if relevant), strict per-context majority, adaptive block/singleton search and fixed-anchor reference.
timing: This transfer check reports quality, counts and witness calls. CPU/GPU and startup timings of the primary campaign are analyzed separately.
outcomes: Report every dataset and seed. Classification test AUC and accuracy; regression unclipped R2 and MAE. Matched prefix uses same count as min. No tuning on these data or test-dependent fallback.
